metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Theo Recessmore
records.biography_en: In The Recess Petition, Theo Recessmore takes the role of recess advocate. “We need more recess.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small handheld placard with a bold clock pictogram.

records.name: Ivy Crosswalk
records.biography_en: In The Recess Petition, Ivy Crosswalk takes the role of crossing safety petitioner. “The crossing needs a pause.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short sign with a simple zebra crossing pictogram.

records.name: Len Lunchplease
records.biography_en: In The Recess Petition, Len Lunchplease takes the role of school lunch campaigner. “It is possible to have seconds.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: miniature placard showing a plain bowl and spoon.

records.name: Ollie Clipcount
records.biography_en: In The Recess Petition, Ollie Clipcount takes the role of petition clipboard keeper. “We're at almost everybody.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small clipboard with large blank boxes and pencil.

records.name: Mara Chalkbanner
records.biography_en: In The Recess Petition, Mara Chalkbanner takes the role of peaceful sign maker. “Leave a space for the tree.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one compact board with a large chalk nub and a simple schoolyard tree picture.

records.name: Bert Megaphone
records.biography_en: In The Recess Petition, Bert Megaphone takes the role of nervous spokesperson. “I wrote it down in case I forget.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one little cone-shaped megaphone with rounded edge held at chest.
